step_1_recover_the_build_AP.method: Both candidate values must be Syndra ability damages at one common AP and one common mitigation multiplier m (S8). Solving the only pair of wiki rows that admits an exact simultaneous solution: 713 = m*(230 + 0.70*AP)  [Q rank 5, S2] and 894 = m*(480 + 0.60*AP)  [R rank 3 minimum / 3 spheres, S3+S4].
step_1_recover_the_build_AP.solve: 713*(480 + 0.6A) = 894*(230 + 0.7A)  ->  342240 + 427.8A = 205620 + 625.8A  ->  198A = 136620  ->  A = 690.0, and then m = 713/713 = 1.0 (target at 0 effective MR, consistent with a 'manual_target' dummy).
step_1_recover_the_build_AP.cross_check: 690 = 600 x 1.15 exactly — i.e. 600 AP amplified by the 120-Splinter Transcendence buff (S1, S7), which is exactly what the scenario id '...custom_order_120' denotes. A brute-force sweep over every Syndra damage row (Q/W/E ranks 1-5, R ranks 1-3 x 1-7 spheres) found only two AP values making BOTH numbers exact: A=690 with (Q rank5, R rank3 x3) and A=890 with (Q rank1, R rank2 x3). The second requires a level-18 Syndra at Q rank 1 / R rank 2 and an AP of 890 with no relation to the 1.15 buff; the first is the maxed rank set (Q5/W5/E5/R3) and reproduces the 15% capstone exactly. A=690 is adopted.

step_2_value_of_every_event_at_AP_690.R, 3 spheres (default sphere count): 3 * 298.0 = 894.0  ==  480 + 0.60*690 = 894.0 (the wiki 'Minimum Magic Damage' row, S4) — two independent rows agree

step_3_identify_the_leaf.finding: The diff is not a re-computation of one ability's damage — it is a change of WHICH slot occupies index 6. 713.0 is exactly a Dark Sphere (Q or the synthetic Q2 charge); 894.0 is exactly Unleashed Power at 3 spheres. No sphere count n satisfies n*298 = 713, and no rank/AP combination makes 894 a Dark Sphere at this build, so each number belongs to one and only one slot.
step_3_identify_the_leaf.event_layout: At 120 splinters the modelled damaging slots are Q, Q2, W(magic) , W(true), E, R (S7) = 6 ability events; a 7-element damage_events list (index 6 = last) therefore has exactly one non-ability event (an auto) alongside them. Old list ended on a Dark Sphere (713) with R earlier; the new list ends on R (894).
step_3_identify_the_leaf.ruling: For a Syndra burst rotation the ultimate is the terminal cast: both Dark Sphere charges (Q, Q2) are spent before Unleashed Power — R consumes/needs spheres on the field and is the finisher (S3: 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones'). An ordering that fires a Dark Sphere charge AFTER the ultimate is the un-physical one; the per-cast damage of Q is unchanged either way, so the only thing at stake at this leaf is the ordering, and R-last is the correct ordering (S9: event order comes from the fight's cast_order).

derivation.conclusion: damage_events[6] should be the Unleashed Power event: 3 spheres x (160 + 20% x 690 AP) = 3 x 298 = 894.0 magic damage, taken at face value against the 0-effective-MR manual target (m = 100/(100+0) = 1, S8). The new value reproduces this exactly.

independent_computation.AP_derivation: 600 base x 1.15 Transcendence (120 Splinters of Wrath)
independent_computation.formula: R (rank 3) = spheres x (160 + 20% AP), spheres = 3 (minimum barrage)

confidence: high on the arithmetic (AP = 690 is the unique simultaneous solution, and 894.0 is reproduced by two independent wiki rows); medium-high on the slot attribution, since the scenario's literal cast_order lives outside data/ and could not be read under the runbook. If a future reader can see the cast order and it deliberately places a Dark Sphere charge after R at index 6, this verdict should be revisited — but 894.0 would still be the correct value for the R event wherever it lands, and 713.0 would still be the correct value for a Dark Sphere event.
caveats: Both 713.0 and 894.0 are individually valid Syndra damage numbers at this build; neither is arithmetically wrong. The verdict turns on event ordering, not on a mis-scaled formula.
The R execute at 100 splinters is documented as not modelled (S7) and does not affect this leaf.
